mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, user_type, nickname, phone, email, status, create_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{userType}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, 1, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT user_id, username, user_type, nickname, phone, email, status, create_time FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND user_type = #{userType}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
